hash_policy.github_blob_sha1: Exact GitHub Git blob object ID from the upstream repository at the recorded commit. Verify with git hash-object on an identical checked-in snapshot.
hash_policy.sha256: The repository verifier computes SHA-256 locally for audit output over checked-in dossier files and mirrors. It is not claimed as a provider-supplied signature.
hash_policy.docs_page_capture: Docs pages are captured as technical extracts with canonical URLs and retrieval dates; they are not byte-pinned to a provider-side version unless a stable upstream file is mirrored.

stonfi_dex_rest_v1.api_version: DEX REST API v1; docs build v1.168.0; official JS client @ston-fi/api 0.33.0

endpoints_used_by_radar.stats: GET /v1/stats -> LEGACY, NOT PRESENT in current documented surface; documented stats endpoints are /v1/stats/dex, /v1/stats/pool, /v1/stats/operations, /v1/stats/fees, /v1/stats/fee_accruals, /v1/stats/fee_withdrawals

stonfi_dex_rest_v1.published_limits: Docs state "Currently, there are no limits for DEX API use." A no-published-limit statement is not an unlimited polling license; the radar keeps self-imposed round-robin budgets and bounds.

verified_response_fields.asset: contract_address, decimals, symbol, kind, blacklisted, community, default_symbol, deprecated, display_name, image_url, dex_price_usd, third_party_price_usd, priority, taxable, wallet_address, popularity_index, tags, custom_payload_api_uri, scale, extensions; V2 variant wraps display fields in meta{decimals, symbol, display_name, image_url, custom_payload_api_uri}
verified_response_fields.pool: address, token0_address, token1_address, reserve0, reserve1, router_address, lp_fee, protocol_fee, protocol_fee_address, ref_fee, lp_total_supply, collected_token0_protocol_fee, collected_token1_protocol_fee, deprecated, apy_1d, apy_7d, apy_30d, volume_24h_usd, tags, amp, rate, w0

stonfi_dex_rest_v1.license_status: Official JS client ston-fi/api is MIT at pinned commit; mirrored type files are inert reference snapshots, not runtime dependencies.

omniston_v1beta8.api_version: stonfi.omni.v1beta8 (current API namespace per official docs); JSON-RPC 2.0 over WebSocket, plus gRPC over TLS
omniston_v1beta8.verified_quote_fields: quote_id, settlementData.$case (swap or order), input_units, output_units, integrator_fee_units, protocol_fee_units, integrator_fee_pips, protocol_fee_pips (1 pip = 1/1,000,000)
omniston_v1beta8.auth: none documented on the pages captured
omniston_v1beta8.notes: RFQ quotes are candidate evidence only; BuildSwap/BuildEscrowTransfer/RegisterSignedOrder/Track and all settlement flows are outside the research radar. The repo adapter keeps Omniston as an injected read-only reader interface; no socket transport is created by this owner.

endpoints_used_by_radar.pools: GET /v2/pools -> bare JSON array of pool objects; no pagination documented; 400 returns {}

verified_response_fields.pool: address, lt, totalSupply, type (e.g. volatile), tradeFee, assets[{type: native|jetton, address?, metadata{name, symbol, image, decimals}}], lastPrice, reserves[string, string], stats{fees[], volume[]}
verified_response_fields.numeric_encoding: All numeric values are returned as strings; reserves/fees/volume are provider-reported and not exact chain state.

dedust_api_v2.license_status: SDK @dedust/sdk is a separate TypeScript package not mirrored here; no SDK dependency added.

swapcoffee_aggregator_v1.api_version: Aggregator REST API v1 (OpenAPI-documented entity pages)
swapcoffee_aggregator_v1.verified_request_params: blockchains (enum ton), dexes (enum incl. stonfi, dedust, coffee, tonco), trusted (default true), with_active_boosts, recently_created, with_liquidity_from, search_text, order (tvl|volume|apr), descending_order, in_groups, size (int 1..100, default 10), page (int >=1, default 1)

verified_response_fields.pool: dex, address, type (public|private|slumbering|invalid), amm_type (constant_product|cubic_stable|curve_fi_stable|concentrated_v3|tonstakers|weighted_constant_product|weighted_stable|bidask|moon_dlmm|bidask_damm|dedust_v2), tokens[{address{blockchain, address}, metadata{name, symbol, decimals, listed, verification: whitelisted|blacklisted|community|unknown}}], reserves (doubles), fees{average_gas, divider, input, output, first_token, second_token}, amm_settings?, restrictions?, unavailable_until? (UTC unix seconds)
verified_response_fields.info: address, tvl_usd, volume_usd, fee_usd, apr, lp_apr, boost_apr, locked_asset_amount?

swapcoffee_aggregator_v1.auth: public API allows unauthorized access; heavier users request an API key (X-Api-Key header) via the official Typeform
swapcoffee_aggregator_v1.published_limits: "We believe that the average load of 1 request per second per IP is more than acceptable." Exceeding yields 429 Too Many Requests. The radar self-imposes 1 page per poll round with bounded page size and backoff.
swapcoffee_aggregator_v1.notes: Routes/pre-built-transaction endpoints are out of scope: no route/quote promotion, no transaction building.

tonco.blocker: No official REST/HTTP pool-state schema is published in the captured docs; Tonco documents a TypeScript SDK (cryptoalgebra/tonco-sdk) that reads concentrated-liquidity pool state through TON providers. Exact contract addresses and SDK generation were not pinned this wave.
tonco.notes: swap.coffee aggregates Tonco pools via its dexes enum (verified), so Tonco pool candidates can still enter the research universe through the swap.coffee adapter without any Tonco-specific code.

toncenter.api_version: v2 (swagger UI at /api/v2) and v3 (swagger at /api/v3); exact per-method schemas not pinned this wave
toncenter.auth: API key plans via TON docs "Get API key"; unauthenticated requests stay at 1 RPS even with a subscription

published_limits.anonymous: 1 request per second (default rate limit without API key)
published_limits.over_limit_response: HTTP 429 with body {"ok": false, "result": "Ratelimit exceed", "code": 429}; docs recommend exponential backoff

toncenter.blocker: Exact request/response schemas for state-read methods (e.g. getAccountState/getExtendedAccountInformation/runGetMethod) were not captured from the official swagger this wave; no state adapter may decode them until pinned.

tonapi.verified_endpoints: GET /v2/accounts/{account_id} (production example on the official page), POST /v2/accounts/_bulk, GET /v2/blockchain/transactions/{transaction_id}, GET /v2/blockchain/config, POST /v2/blockchain/message, GET /v2/wallet/emulate; swagger UI at https://tonapi.io/api-v2
tonapi.auth: API key plans exist; key header name not captured this wave
tonapi.blocker: Exact /v2/accounts/{account_id} and jetton response schemas were not captured verbatim this wave; a TonAPI state-view adapter may not decode unverified field layouts.

known_contract_drift.problem: The radar polls GET /v1/stats and decodes {"stats": {...}}. The current documented STON.fi surface (docs build v1.168.0) does not list plain /v1/stats; documented stats endpoints are /v1/stats/dex, /v1/stats/pool, /v1/stats/operations, /v1/stats/fees, /v1/stats/fee_accruals, /v1/stats/fee_withdrawals, and the official SDK 0.33.0 calls only /v1/stats/operations, /v1/stats/fees, /v1/stats/fee_withdrawals.
known_contract_drift.corrective_target: Keep the legacy {"stats": {...}} decode contract with fail-closed SCHEMA_ERROR handling until a live capture is authorized, then either confirm the legacy endpoint or pin the exact /v1/stats/dex response schema and migrate. Do not invent a /v1/stats/dex decoder.

known_contract_drift.problem: Asset rows exist in two verified variants: flat AssetInfoResponse (symbol at top level) and V2 AssetInfoV2Response (symbol/decimals inside meta{}).
known_contract_drift.corrective_target: The existing normalizer already accepts both variants and keeps provider metadata out of on-chain decimals; keep tests covering both.

live_capture_blockers.scope: All TON sources this wave: STON.fi REST, Omniston WS, DeDust API, swap.coffee API, TON Center, TonAPI. No live request was made and no live payload is claimed as evidence.
